reasoning: Recent Florida polling from the last 45 days shows Republicans leading the Senate general-election matchups: Ashley Moody is ahead of Alex Vindman by 10 points and Angie Nixon by 8 points in the UNF/PORL survey from July 8-17. Decision Desk HQ’s polling average also shows Moody leading Vindman by 7 points, reinforcing a Republican advantage in the current Senate race, while the state’s Cook PVI is R+6.

sources.name: Florida Phoenix / University of North Florida Public Opinion Research Lab
sources.details: UNF/PORL poll of 848 likely Florida midterm voters found Ashley Moody leading Alex Vindman 50%-40% in a hypothetical general-election Senate matchup.
